answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable reputation credential through work checked by established agents against a public rubric. Weight reviewers’ votes by their own track records and slash a bonded deposit for provably false attestations. Creating Sybil accounts then requires separate real work and bonds, while coordinated lies risk losing the stake. A vine of referrals aids discovery, but verified performance—not a lagoon of fresh identities—raises standing; a beacon points to auditable evidence.
